commonNames.name: James' Sportive Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Lepilemur jamesorum Louis Jr., Engberg, Lei, Geng, Sommer, Randriamampionona, Randriamanana, Zaonarivelo et al., 2006

wikipedia.extract: James' sportive lemur (Lepilemur jamesi), or the Manombo sportive lemur, is a sportive lemur endemic to Madagascar. Like all members of its genus, it is nocturnal and largely folivorous.
wikipedia.title: James' sportive lemur

wikipedia.extract: Phaps is a genus of bronzewing pigeons in the family Columbidae that are native to Australia. The genus was introduced in 1835 by the English naturalist Prideaux John Selby with the common bronzewing (Phaps chalcoptera) as the type species.
wikipedia.title: Phaps

commonNames.name: Crowned Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The crested mona monkey, also known as the crowned guenon, crowned monkey, golden-bellied guenon, or golden-bellied monkey, (Cercopithecus pogonias), is a species of African primate in the family Cercopithecidae found in west central Africa.
wikipedia.title: Crested mona monkey

commonNames.name: Northern Pig-tailed Macaque
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The northern pig-tailed macaque (Macaca leonina) is a vulnerable species of macaque in the subfamily Cercopithecidae. It is found in Bangladesh, Cambodia, China, India, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand, and Vietnam.
wikipedia.title: Northern pig-tailed macaque

wikipedia.extract: The giant hummingbirds are hummingbirds of the genus Patagona. The genus includes two species, the sedentary giant hummingbird and the migratory giant hummingbird, which are the largest and second largest species of hummingbird respectively.
wikipedia.title: Patagona

commonNames.name: Colombian White-throated Capuchin
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Colombian white-faced capuchin (Cebus capucinus), also known as the Colombian white-headed capuchin or Colombian white-throated capuchin, is a medium-sized New World monkey of the family Cebidae, subfamily Cebinae. It is native to the extreme eastern portion of Panama and the extreme north-western portion of South America in western Colombia and northwestern Ecuador.
wikipedia.title: Colombian white-faced capuchin

wikipedia.extract: Thermus aquaticus (Latin for "hot water") is a species of bacteria that can tolerate high temperatures, one of several thermophilic bacteria that belong to the Deinococcota phylum. It is the source of the heat-resistant enzyme Taq DNA polymerase, one of the most important enzymes in molecular biology because of its use in the polymerase chain reaction (PCR) DNA amplification technique.
wikipedia.title: Thermus aquaticus

commonNames.name: Panamanian Night Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Panamanian night monkey or Chocoan night monkey (Aotus zonalis) is a species of night monkey formerly considered a subspecies of the gray-bellied night monkey of the family Aotidae. Its range consists of Panama and the Chocó region of Colombia.
wikipedia.title: Panamanian night monkey

wikipedia.extract: Rallus is a genus of wetland birds of the rail family. Sometimes, the genera Lewinia and Gallirallus are included in it.
wikipedia.title: Rallus

wikipedia.extract: Neodrepanis is a bird genus in the family Philepittidae.
wikipedia.title: Neodrepanis

wikipedia.extract: Balaenicipitidae is a family of birds in the order Pelecaniformes, although it was traditionally placed in Ciconiiformes. The shoebill is the sole extant species and its closest relative is the hamerkop (Scopus umbretta), which belongs to another family.
wikipedia.title: Balaenicipitidae

wikipedia.extract: Phlogophilus, or the piedtails, are a small genus of hummingbirds. It contains two species.
wikipedia.title: Phlogophilus

wikipedia.extract: The banded kingfisher (Lacedo pulchella) is a tree kingfisher found in lowland tropical forests of southeast Asia. It is the only member of the genus Lacedo.
wikipedia.title: Banded kingfisher

commonNames.name: Azara’s Capuchin
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Azaras's capuchin or hooded capuchin (Sapajus cay) is a species of robust capuchin. It occurs in eastern Paraguay, southeastern Bolivia, northern Argentina, and Brazil, at Mato Grosso do Sul and Mato Grosso states, in Pantanal.
wikipedia.title: Azaras's capuchin

wikipedia.extract: Eutoxeres is a genus of hummingbird in the family Trochilidae.
wikipedia.title: Eutoxeres

commonNames.name: Colombian Black-handed Titi
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Colombian black-handed titi monkey (Cheracebus medemi) is a species of titi, a type of New World monkey, endemic to Colombia. It was originally described in the genus Callicebus in 1963.
wikipedia.title: Colombian black-handed titi monkey

wikipedia.extract: Catopithecus is an early catarrhine fossil. It is known from more than 16 specimens of a single species, Catopithecus browni, found in the Jebel Qatrani Formation of the Faiyum Governorate, Egypt.
wikipedia.title: Catopithecus

commonNames.name: Lomami Red Colobus
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Lomami red colobus (Piliocolobus parmentieri) is a species of red colobus monkey from central Africa. Historically, it had been treated as a subspecies of the Central African red colobus (P. foai), but more recent taxonomies generally treat it as a separate species.
wikipedia.title: Lomami red colobus

commonNames.name: Holland's Sportive Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Lepilemur hollandorum Ramaromilanto, Lei, Engberg, Johnson, Sitzmann & Louis Jr., 2009

wikipedia.extract: Holland's sportive lemur (Lepilemur hollandorum), or the Mananara-Nord sportive lemur, is a sportive lemur that is endemic to Madagascar. It is one of 26 species in the genus Lepilemur.
wikipedia.title: Holland's sportive lemur
